verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API that "lets you manage data and features in sevdesk," so the API is a first-party capability. Nothing shows it reaches parity with the UI: no evidence maps UI features such as ELSTER VAT filing, dunning, bank payments or invoice layouts to API endpoints, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API feature parity, endpoint coverage for key workflows (VAT returns, dunning, banking, document design), a published machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
